pages.title: Publications
pages._note: The Woo publication pipeline (woo-publicatie-pipeline): the list and one publication with its checks, metadata, hand-off, withdrawal, destruction date and history. type:custom because it reads GET api/publications, which lists only publications whose document the caller can open, and every action is a pipeline step on that API, not an object edit.

pages.title: Print jobs
pages._note: The caller's own print jobs with status and download (print-jobs-in-the-app). type:custom because it reads GET api/print/jobs, which lists only the caller's jobs; the PDFs are in app data, not in the object.

pages.title: Legal holds
pages._note: The hold register (e-discovery-legal-hold): legal matters and the records they freeze, with placement per record, retry and release. type:custom because it reads GET api/legal-holds, which serves hold authority only (admins plus legal_hold_authority_groups); the legalHoldCase schema itself is admin-only in OpenRegister.

pages.title: Erasure requests
pages._note: Subject erasure (erase-a-person-while-the-records-stay): record a request, read the capped preview, leave occurrences in place with a reason, run, read the certificate. type:custom because the preview and the run are computed by api/subject-erasures, which checks the erasure authority (admins plus subject_erasure_groups) before anything is read.

pages.title: Entity search
pages._note: Entity search (entity-search): search OpenRegister's detected-entity catalogue and see per document where a value occurs. type:custom because api/entity-search checks the gate (admins plus entity_search.allowed_groups), scopes by organisation and writes the processing log before it answers; the menu entry shows only when GET api/entity-search/access answers 200 (manifest.runtime.entitySearch.allowed, set in App.vue).
